description: React component for managing group details in Mattermost admin console, including editing group info, managing associated teams and channels, and viewing users.

classes.name: GroupDetails
classes.description: React component class for managing and editing group details, including roles, channels, teams, and members.

methods.name: componentDidMount
methods.description: Fetches group data, syncables, and stats on component mount.

methods.name: componentDidUpdate
methods.description: Updates state when group channels or teams change.

methods.name: addTeams
methods.description: Adds selected teams to the group.

methods.name: addChannels
methods.description: Adds selected channels to the group.

methods.name: onRemoveTeamOrChannel
methods.description: Removes a team or channel from the group.

methods.name: syncableTypeFromEntryType
methods.description: Converts entry type string to SyncableType enum.

methods.name: onChangeRoles
methods.description: Updates role (admin) status for a team or channel.

methods.name: onMentionChange
methods.description: Handles change in group mention name input.

methods.name: handleSubmit
methods.description: Handles saving all changes to group, teams, channels, and roles.

methods.name: roleChangeKey
methods.description: Generates a key for role changes based on team or channel ID and type.

methods.name: handlePatchGroup
methods.description: Patches group info such as allow_reference and name.

methods.name: handleRolesToUpdate
methods.description: Updates roles (admin status) for teams and channels.

methods.name: handleAddedTeamsAndChannels
methods.description: Links newly added teams and channels to the group.

methods.name: handleRemovedTeamsAndChannels
methods.description: Unlinks removed teams and channels from the group.
